{{Quote|I would say that rebuilding housing is our first priority. There are so many who were displaced by the war.|Nena, to the Young advisory council|<ref name="TUP" />}}
'''Nena''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] that headed the [[Housing Squad]] after the [[Battle of Zehava (Young–Elders War)|Battle of Zehava]]. Like other squad leaders who thought their projects were most important, Nena believed that rebuilding the housing destroyed during the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]] should be the [[the Young]]'s top priority.<ref name="TUP" />
